Usage: mailctl ldap sync|sync-log|health
  ldap sync                trigger an immediate LDAP sync (POST /admin/ldap/sync)
  ldap sync-log            show recent sync log entries (GET /admin/ldap/sync-log)
  ldap health              show connectivity + last-sync status (GET /admin/ldap/health)

Flags (all subcommands): --json, --quiet, --yes/-y
